english.meaning: a formal linking word, like of, between two nouns
english.note: Seen in 不足之處 (shortcomings) and 總數之一 (one of the total). This meaning is less certain: it was read from a few recorded conversations.

exampleSentences.english: As I said earlier, this book has its strengths, but also its shortcomings.
exampleSentences.traditional: 噉正如頭先講呢，就哩一本書呢𠻺有佢嘅好處，但係亦都有不足之處嘅。

exampleSentences.english: Hebrews 11:1—let me read it: “Faith is the substance of things hoped for, the evidence of things not seen.” Nope.
exampleSentences.traditional: 希伯來書，十一章，一節，等我讀喇，「信就是所望之事的實底，是未見之事的確據」冇嚹。
